fullPassage: "Human nature likes order," wrote the economist Burton Malkiel in his seminal book A Random Walk Down Wall Street. "People find it hard to accept the notion of randomness." Malkiel popularized the idea that the movement of any individual stock in the market is essentially random — it's impossible to know why a stock is doing what it's doing. People who reliably make money from the market are those who own a diverse portfolio of different kinds of investments, which spreads out the risk, with the broader principle that the market, over the long haul, will eventually increase in value. Picking individual stocks, or betting on certain trends, is much closer to gambling than science. Which is why we shouldn't be too surprised that a cat is just as likely to make a killing on Wall Street as a day trader.

questions.passage: "Human nature likes order," wrote the economist Burton Malkiel in his seminal book A Random Walk Down Wall Street. "People ①<u>find</u> it hard to accept the notion of randomness." Malkiel ②<u>popularized</u> the idea that the movement of any individual stock in the market is essentially random — it's impossible to know why a stock is doing what it's doing. People who reliably make money from the market are those who own a diverse portfolio of different kinds of investments, which spreads out the risk, with the broader principle that the market, over the long haul, will eventually increase in value. Picking individual stocks, or ③<u>bet</u> on certain trends, is much closer to gambling than science. Which is why we shouldn't be too ④<u>surprised</u> that a cat is just as likely to make a killing on Wall Street as a day trader.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
① find: 'People find it hard'에서 주어 People(복수) 뒤 복수동사 find가 맞음 ✅

② popularized: 'Malkiel popularized the idea'는 과거동사라 맞음 ✅

③ bet → betting: 'Picking individual stocks, or bet on certain trends'에서 or 앞의 Picking(동명사)과 병렬되어야 하므로 betting이 맞음. 동사원형 bet은 병렬 구조를 깨뜨림 ❌ ← 정답

④ surprised: 'we shouldn't be too surprised'에서 주어 we는 감정을 느끼는 대상이라 과거분사 surprised가 맞음 ✅
det.tip: A, or B 병렬: Picking(동명사) ... or betting(동명사). bet(원형)은 병렬 위반.

(1) closer, gambling, is, much, science, than, to 를 모두 사용할 것

det.korean: 과학보다 도박에 훨씬 더 가깝다 — is much closer to gambling than science
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- is(동사): ~이다
- much closer(비교급 강조): 훨씬 더 가까운 (much가 비교급 closer를 강조)
- to gambling(전치사구): 도박에
- than science(비교 대상): 과학보다
- 'A is much closer to X than Y' = A는 Y보다 X에 훨씬 더 가깝다
det.tip: 비교급 강조 much + closer. close to A than B = B보다 A에 더 가까운.
